## Goal

Open the prepared bug report at issue.md (repo root) on the upstream
PSPTool repository [PSPReverse/PSPTool](https://github.com/PSPReverse/PSPTool)
and track adoption.

## Background

issue.md (~340 lines / 16 KB) is a complete, ready-to-submit bug report
written 2026-05-07 with:

* Root-cause analysis of why every directory in single-generation EPYC
  BIOSes returns zen_generation=None silently (no combo_dir, no
  tertiary self-tag — neither of PSPTool's two existing detection paths
  fires).
* Concrete fix proposal: third detection path via PSP_FW_BOOT_LOADER
  (entry type 0x01) version major.minor, with an empirically-validated
  mapping table.
* 17 publicly-downloadable test ROMs (URLs return HTTP 200 as of
  authoring) spanning Zen 2 -> Zen 5 with post-unwrap SHA-256s, vendor
  unwrap notes (ASUS .CAP + 0x800 strip, Tyan .bin/.rom selection,
  ASRock direct .ROM), a one-liner repro using psp-etl, and a
  pytest.parametrize regression-test stub.
* 2 positive controls (combo-dir AM4 ROMs that already work) so the fix
  cannot regress existing detection.

## Steps

1. Read /home/vringar/projects/AMD-PSP/projects/psp-etl/issue.md.
2. Sanity-check links: every download URL in issue.md was 200 at
   authoring; verify they still resolve before forwarding.
3. Open https://github.com/PSPReverse/PSPTool/issues/new and paste
   the contents of issue.md verbatim. Add a brief "filed via psp-etl
   downstream tooling" preamble if useful.
4. Add a comment on this crosslink issue with the upstream issue URL
   and the date.
5. Close this issue once filed; track downstream-relevant outcomes
   (a fix lands, a release ships, etc.) under separate follow-up
   issues if needed.

## Why this is low priority

CL-100 already implements the downstream workaround (backfill from
image.agesa_version), so we are not blocked on the upstream landing.
Filing it remains valuable because:

* Helps the PSPTool community (other downstream consumers face the
  same silent gap with EPYC BIOSes).
* If the upstream fix lands, we can simplify ingest.py by removing
  the agesa-based fallback path.

Refs: CL-100, the issue.md artifact in repo root.
